newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul stocks seen weakening on consolidation.
newsitem.headline: Seoul stocks seen weakening on consolidation.

text.p: Seoul stocks are expected to continue consolidating on Monday with selling focused on large-capitalised shares, brokers said.
"Fundamentals have not improved to the extent investors had anticipated," said Jo Jae-hoon at Daewoo Securities. "The market is likely to fall to the 745 level."
The composite stock index closed on Saturday at 760.40, down 9.82 points.
Brokers said cars, semiconductors and petrochemical shares, which are the nation's key export items, would lead the index fall. -- Yeom Yoon-jeong (822) 727 5647
